# Digital Dollar Store — llms.txt
# Operator: J-Dawgs Industries (Joshua Dawson), Springfield, Missouri. https://jdawgsindustries.com

The Digital Dollar Store sells downloadable games and apps for a one-time purchase — no subscription, no account needed, no ads ever, and we never sell your information. Every game and app is $1 unless marked (Scotty's Job Site Calculator is 99 cents; the J-Dawgs Prompt Generator is $2.99; Hustle City Drag Racing is $1.99).

## Main pages
- [Home — $1 games & apps](https://digitaldollarstore.org/): downloadable games and apps, one-time purchase.
- [Catalog](https://digitaldollarstore.org/catalog.html): the full shelf of games, apps and tools.
- [Hustle City Arcade](https://digitaldollarstore.org/arcade/): play Hustle City games online.
- [Free Wallpapers](https://digitaldollarstore.org/free-wallpapers.html)

## Games and apps
- [Hustle City Solitaire](https://digitaldollarstore.org/hustle-city-solitaire.html): Klondike solitaire with big, easy-to-read cards. $1 one time.
- [Hustle City Drag Racing](https://digitaldollarstore.org/hustle-city-drag-racing.html): drag racing game. $1.99 one time.
- [Draw Pad](https://digitaldollarstore.org/draw-pad.html): simple drawing pad app. $1 one time.
- [Create with J-Dawg](https://digitaldollarstore.org/create-with-j-dawg.html): full drawing studio app. $1 one time.
- [Scotty's Job Site Calculator](https://digitaldollarstore.org/scottys-job-site-calculator.html): job site calculator. 99 cents.
- [Classic Games](https://digitaldollarstore.org/apps/classic-games/): classic games app collection.
